headline: Public hearing on a variance to build a single-family home at 384 Butman Road, plus sign and addition requests.
summary: Four petitions are listed, including a home at 384 Butman Road and illuminated signs at 2 Prince Avenue and 524 Chelmsford Street. An addition at 65 Garden Road is also on the list.
items: Variance to build a single-family home at 384 Butman Road (continued business)
Special permit for an illuminated sign at 2 Prince Avenue
Special permit for an internally illuminated sign at 524 Chelmsford Street
Variance to build an addition at 65 Garden Road
location: City Council Chambers, 375 Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852
plain_text:
City of Lowell  
Zoning Board of Appeals Agenda  
  
11/9/2026 at 6:30 PM  
  
The City of Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a meeting on Monday, November 
9, 2026 at 6:30 PM.  
  
Meetings will be held in the City Council Chambers  at 375 
Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852 with public welcome and by using 
remote participation as follows: 
 
Members of the public may view the meeting via ltc.org, or local cable 
channel 6. Those wishing to speak regarding a specific agenda item 
shall register to speak in advance of the meeting by sending an email to 
dricker@lowellma.gov,  pcutrumbes@lowellma.gov AND 
mbrundage@lowellma.gov indicating the agenda item and a phone 
number to call so that you may be issued zoom link to the meeting. If 
no access to email, you may contact Development Services at 978-674-
4144. All requests must occur prior to 4:00PM on the day of meeting.  
 
For help with zoom please visit: Joining a Zoom meeting – Zoom Support 
 
 Review all application documents online at: https://www.lowellma.gov/1099/Zoning-Board   
 
I. Continued Business 
 
ZBA-2026-37  
Petition Type: Variances  
Applicant: Mullane Construction, LLC  
Property Located at: 384 Butman Road, 01852  
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 5.1  
Petition: The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a public hearing to hear all interested persons  relative to an 
application by  Mullane Construction, LLC to construct a single -family home at 384 Butman Road. The subject 
property is located in the Suburban Single-Family (SSF) zoning district. The project requires Variance  approval per 
Section 5.1 for relief from the  minimum frontage, minimum lot area, and minimum lot area per dwelling unit 
requirements, and for any other relief required under the Lowell Zoning Ordinance 
  
II. New Business 
 
ZBA-2026-45 
Petition Type: Special Permit 
Applicant: The Markley Group 
Property Located at: 2 Prince Avenue, 01852 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 6.3.4 
Petition: The Markley Group has applied to the Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals to install an illuminated sign on the 
side of the building at 2 Prince Avenue. The sign will face Gorham and Livingston Streets. The subject property is 
located in the Light Industrial (LI) zoning district. The proposal requires a Special Permit per Section 6.3.4 to install 
and illuminate the sign, and any other relief required under the City of Lowell Zoning Ordinance.
ZBA-2026-46 
Petition Type: Special Permit 
Applicant: Leidis Santana 
Property Located at: 524 Chelmsford Street, 01851 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 6.3 
Petition: Leidis Santana has applied to The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals to erect an internally illuminated sign at 
524 Chelmsford Street. The subject property is located in the Regional Retail (RR) zoning district. The proposal 
requires Special Permit approval per Section 6.3 for internally illuminated signage.  
 
ZBA-2026-47 
Petition Type: Variance 
Applicant: Heather and Jeffrey Brunini 
Property Located at: 65 Garden Road, 01852 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 5.1 
Petition: Heather and Jeffrey Brunini have applied to The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals to construct an addition 
at 65 Garden Road. The subject property is located in the Suburban Single-Family (SSF) zoning district. The proposal 
requires a Variance per Section 5.1 for relief from maximum Floor to Area (FAR) ratio and any other relief require d 
under the City of Lowell Zoning Ordinance. 
 
III. Other Business 
 
Minutes for Approval:  
10/26/2026 
 
 
Per Order of the City of Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals – Van Pech, Chairman 
New business to be advertised by October 25, 2026 and November 1, 2026
